note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Irregular cloudy/cracked mottle overlays the green panel at 1:1 and reads as lichen or cracks; rivets look soft and dark-blurred.
flags.fix: Cut the mottle amplitude or drop its low-frequency component; keep only the fine grain. Sharpen the rivet edges slightly.

flags.problem: Dense reddish rust speckle covers the whole grey panel, not just the orange band, so the material reads as rusty sheet rather than the clean grey original.
flags.fix: Restrict the rust speckle to the orange top band or cut its density and red chroma on the grey panel areas.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the yellow chevron outline is soft and smeared, with thick blurred edges rather than the crisp thin decal line of the original.
flags.fix: Re-do the decal with an edge-preserving upscale (or nearest-edge plus light unsharp) so the outline stays a thin crisp line at 1:1.

flags.problem: Grain at 1:1 is scattered light dots, not the vertical brushed streaks the recipe describes, so it reads as grit rather than brushed sheet metal.
flags.fix: Replace the isotropic speckle with vertically elongated brushed grain, or lower the amplitude so it reads as subtle streaks.
